top_signals.title: Tech Stocks Waver Before Nvidia’s First Earnings Post-Huang
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks struggled for direction on Tuesday as investors looked to an all-important earnings release from Nvidia Corp., while the selloff in the artificial intelligence trade eased.

top_signals.title: Kazakhstan Has Given Over $1 Billion of Loans Lending to emerging metal tycoon
top_signals.summary: Kazakh investment holding Baiterek lent more than $1 billion to two mining companies run by Nurlan Artykbayev, underlining the state support provided to businessmen who rose to prominence under President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
